export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec109/fx" && cd -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
r=json.load(open('system-spec/fetched-references.json'))
for x in r['references']: print(x['target_id'],x['source_url'],x.get('version'),x.get('last_updated'),x['retrieved_at'],x['latest_checked_at'],'\n  ',x['summary'][:300])
s=json.load(open('system-spec/spec-state.json'))
print(s['targets']);print(json.dumps(s.get('knowledge_candidates'),ensure_ascii=False)[:1200])
for d in s['decisions']: print(d['id'],d.get('status'),d.get('selected'),[ (o.get('id'),o.get('evidence_refs')) for o in d.get('options',[])])
PY
